item.title: MARTA launches new on-demand transit service on March 7
item.description: MARTA is launching MARTA Reach, an on-demand transit service providing flexible, point-to-point shared rides in 12 zones in metro Atlanta, with the service running 18 hours a day, seven days a week, and fares starting at $2.50 on March 28. The post MARTA launches new on-demand transit service on March 7 appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Three Black candidates aim to break Georgia’s Secretary of State glass ceiling
item.description: Three Black Americans, Penny Brown Reynolds, Adrian Consonery, Jr., and Kelvin King, are running for the position of Georgia Secretary of State, and if elected, one of them would be the first Black person to hold the office. The post Three Black candidates aim to break Georgia’s Secretary of State glass ceiling appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: UPS Store Opens Redesigned Storefront at JA BizTown
item.description: Junior Achievement of Georgia and The UPS Store celebrated the ribbon-cutting of a newly redesigned UPS Store storefront inside JA BizTown, a simulated city designed to give sixth graders exposure to real business decisions. item.description: President Trump announced on social media that he was firing Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem and replacing her with Oklahoma Sen. item.title: The US economy lost 92,000 jobs in February and the unemployment rate rose to 4.4%
item.description: US businesses unexpectedly shed 92,000 jobs in February, resulting in an unemployment rate of 4.4%, due to a combination of factors including a labor strike, cold weather, and a new war in the Middle East. item.title: Clark Atlanta Panthers fall to Miles College in thrilling overtime semifinal
item.description: Clark Atlanta University women's basketball team lost to Miles College 75-72 in overtime in the SIAC tournament semifinals, despite stellar play from junior forward Atronia Garner and senior guard Janiah Ellis. item.title: ‘We Can’t Continue to Have the Bully in the White House’: Esteves Says at Gathering Spot Roundtable
item.description: Jason Esteves, Georgia gubernatorial candidate, hosted a small business roundtable to discuss the challenges entrepreneurs face, such as access to capital, rising costs, and systemic barriers, and to outline his vision for economic growth and support for entrepreneurs.
